scope: Fitted offline point-reuse hypothesis and pre-native scaled prediction; not a production rule
method: Repeat the first-seen point-reuse model with a 0.001 mm Euclidean radius, the second constant observed in a static candidate call. Seed the model with unique source vertices and use the experimental collector order.
existingControlResult: All six modeled distinct vertex sets equal their native output vertex sets. These comparisons were known before selecting the radius; triangle facets were not compared.

independentScaledPrediction.limitation: This predicts vertex membership only, not native triangle facets or whether native preserves coverage.

limitations: The second native constant is stored on a candidate path; it has not been shown to be the point-search radius or used in this way.
The radius was chosen after observing the six controls; the native scaled result is needed for an independent check.
Native tree membership and traversal order remain unobserved and generic snapping can discard real geometry.
No application code, GUI/MCP behavior or native parity is established.
